remarks: Unbelievable opportunity-first time ever on the market! Welcome to a truly rare offering in one of Fairfield County's most desirable communities. Cherished by the same family for over six decades, this well-built single-family home makes its debut on the market, privately set back from the road on a beautiful two-acre parcel. Opportunities like this simply do not come along often. With solid construction, a generous layout, and endless potential, this property is a dream canvas for a visionary homeowner, savvy investor, or builder. While cosmetic updates and some exterior TLC are needed, the underlying value is undeniable. Renovate, reimagine, expand, or build new-the possibilities are wide open, and the location makes every option worthwhile. Enjoy the very best of Wilton living with close proximity to Wilton Center, Metro-North, shopping, dining, Lilly's Market, Orem's Diner, and the Wilton Y.  Peaceful, private, and perfectly positioned, this is the kind of property buyers wait years to find. Offered AS IS and priced for a quick sale, this is your chance to build instant equity and create something truly special in an exceptional community. Bring your contractor, your imagination, and your vision-this one will not last.
